variants.user_notes: Programming through the USB bootloader needs the board in its bootloader (DFU) mode; on many boards, hold its button while plugging it in.

variants.maintainer_notes: Device selection (2026-11-04): --busdev-num ${BUS}:${DEV} added so openFPGALoader opens the device the engine chose, not the first one with these USB IDs. Low risk, so tested is unchanged: openFPGALoader's FTDI drivers (MPSSE, bitbang, CH552) open the device by bus and address when given (src/ftdipp_mpsse.cpp, ftdi_usb_open_bus_addr); not tried on hardware.
